title: Restaurant owner discovers the margin problem after the month is already over
job: Know which controllable inputs are eroding margin early enough to change the week.
trigger: Weekly sales/purchasing data close or food/labor variance spikes.
surfaceComplaint: Sales look okay but there is no money left.
believedCause: Food and labor are just expensive now.
mechanism: Costs are higher, but operators often see blended monthly results after the actionable window. Purchasing, waste, portions, labor and menu mix interact across separate systems.

workflow.friction: decisions made before consolidated margin view

economics.painCostNote: NRA reports restaurant expenses 36% above pre-pandemic levels, so controllable leaks matter more.

buyer.wtp: US$500-2,000/mo if recovered margin is visible
buyer.roiLogic: A 1-point margin gain can be worth thousands/month.

distribution.acquisition: Sell a diagnostic on exports before asking for integrations.

experiment.success: 5/10 pay US$1k+ and median identified/recovered annualized value >5x fee
experiment.kill: data cleanup dominates or operators cannot act

claims.text: National Restaurant Association says total restaurant expenses are 36% above pre-pandemic levels.
The product must connect variance to an intervention, not merely display costs.
